title: Value or Attention: Investigating Layer-wise Relevance Propagation for Graph Attention Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.08088v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph Attention Networks (GATs) are increasingly used in domains where scientists need to read a model's reasoning, from medicine to materials science, yet the routing they learn remains opaque to most explainers. Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) follows the model's computation, but in an attention layer the relevance reaching a node is the sum of two mechanically different quantities: its content relevance through the value path and its routing relevance through the attention path. Existing rules either drop one or add them into a single number. We write a single product rule with free weights on the two factors that recovers current approaches as special cases. The value path measures what content a node supplied against a zero baseline; the attention path measures how the node shaped what was passed relative to its neighborhood, and its sign records whether the node's features moved the gating the way the prediction demanded.

translated_title: 价值还是注意力：面向图注意力网络的逐层相关性传播研究
translated_abstract: 图注意力网络越来越多地应用于从医学到材料科学等需要科学家解读模型推理过程的领域，然而它们所学习到的路由机制对大多数解释方法而言仍然是不透明的。逐层相关性传播（LRP）能够遵循模型的计算过程，但在注意力层中，到达某个节点的相关性是两个机制上截然不同的量的总和：通过值路径传递的内容相关性，以及通过注意力路径传递的路由相关性。现有的规则要么丢弃其中一个部分，要么将它们简单相加成一个数值。我们提出了一个作用于这两个因子、带有自由权重的单一乘积规则，能够将现有方法作为特例加以恢复。值路径衡量的是节点相对于零基线所提供的内容；注意力路径衡量的是节点相对于其邻域如何塑造了传递的信息，其符号记录了节点的特征是否按照预测所需的方式影响了门控机制。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种带自由权重的LRP乘积规则，将图注意力网络中节点接收到的相关性分解为值路径的内容相关性和注意力路径的路由相关性两部分，并将现有解释方法统一为其特例。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a single product rule with free weights for LRP in Graph Attention Networks, decomposing node relevance into content relevance via the value path and routing relevance via the attention path, thereby unifying existing explainability approaches as special cases.
